providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: No spacecraft has ever visited Gonggong; not part of Solar System Scope's illustrative dwarf-planet set (checked live 2026-08-27). Procedurally generated surface parameterized from JWST spectroscopy (tholins/red slope, water ice, methane frost — 2024): red tholin base with patchy brighter methane-frost regions, normal (not reduced) cratering since no resurfacing evidence exists for this body.
